scenes.headline: How the Codex harness runs one turn
scenes.sub: The loop, the sandbox, and the reviewer around it
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Latch! Let's follow one turn through the Codex harness, from the prompt to the sandbox.

scenes.text: The harness is a loop around a model. Context is diffed, tools run under a sandbox, and risky actions can be reviewed by a second model.
scenes.say: The harness is a loop around the model. Context changes as small diffs, tools run in a sandbox, and a second model can review risky actions.

steps.say: The context goes to the model. After the first request, only the changes are added.
Tool calls are run as the model names them, and their results are read back in call order.
A command runs inside a sandbox the harness builds for the platform.
The output goes back into history, and the loop repeats until the model stops asking.

scenes.title: Who decides a command may run
scenes.say: Before a command runs, three layers get a say.

items.say: First, the user's rules match the start of the command and can allow, ask, or forbid.
Then the approval policy decides whether to ask the person.
Optionally, a second model reviews the risky ones and fails closed.

scenes.label: feature flags, most still under development
scenes.say: Around all of it sit two hundred and one feature flags, so the shape keeps moving.

scenes.text: A rule is a convenience. The sandbox is the wall that holds.

scenes.say: Context is diffed, tools run in a sandbox, and a reviewer can say no. Thanks for watching!
